scope: Global maximizer existence; univalent/root-transform/area estimates; actual support-slit identification; orientation and monotonicity consequences
strongest_verified_result: Every maximizer in normalized schlicht S of Re[a2+i10^-24(a4-3a3)] has nonmonotone continuous argument, signed outward radial angle, and unsigned outward radial angle on its actual omitted slit.

minor_findings.description: The numerator 7/2 follows from |H(-2/3)| < 11/6, a direct consequence of (8) and 5 eta < 1/6; the coarser displayed |H|<2 alone would not give that numerator.
minor_findings.suggested_revision: Mention |H(-2/3)|<11/6 immediately before the reciprocal-square estimate.

remaining_gap: No new-argument gap found within this analytic review. Classical theorem proofs and continuous analytic derivations are not machine-formalized. Current novelty, historical priority, and human peer review remain outside this verdict.
